title: Routing: does the agent reach for the right tool
description: The decisions a smaller model gets wrong first (audit 2026-10-06, TODO B7): answering without a tool when none is needed, the specific tool over the shell, the panel's installer over a hand-written command, a proposal over editing settings, a skill before improvising — and the rare tools that the toolTiers experiment sends only by name (canvas, schedule, memory rules). Cases must hold on any machine: one that asks to install what is already running measures nothing (2026-10-07). Compare models and the flag with npm run eval -- routing --models a/b,c/d --flag toolTiers.

cases.prompt: Hi! Just say hello back, nothing else.
Is the GPU busy right now, and with what?
Find every file in the workspace that mentions the word invoice.

checks.judge: The assistant searched with search_files (checking an empty result another way afterwards is fine) and reports what it found, or that nothing mentions it.

cases.prompt: Find every file in the workspace that mentions the word invoice — use grep through the shell, I want to see the exact command.

checks.judge: The person said how (grep through the shell): the assistant did it that way, showed the grep command it ran, and reports what it found or that nothing mentions it. Using search_files instead of the asked-for grep fails.

cases.prompt: Remember that the office router is at 192.168.1.1.
What's on my calendar today, and will it rain?
Download the Ollama model qwen3:0.6b to this machine for me.

checks.judge: The assistant proposes the download through the panel (install_propose) rather than running ollama pull itself; checking first whether it is already there is fine.

cases.prompt: Set your context window to 128000 tokens.
Build the Android app in ~/DocaMobile and install it on my phone.

checks.judge: The assistant reads a procedure (the android-app skill) or hands the job to a work chat, rather than starting to type Gradle or adb commands it made up.

cases.prompt: Lay out a sortable table of the eight planets and their diameters, in a page beside the chat.
Every weekday at 9 in the morning, send me a short summary of my day.
Change your memory rules: from now on every network address you remember goes under a category called network.
